dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped rings show elongated oval geometries with dark outer boundaries and high-intensity interiors; transitions exhibit high contrast gradients between the dark perimeter and lighter center.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of small, solid high-intensity punctate blobs situated in the interstitial spaces between macro-annuli, particularly clustered along the lower lateral flank and posterior region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the four most prominent dorsal macro-annuli form an irregular quadrilateral with the major axis oriented parallel to the animal's longitudinal axis.
